classification.difficultyReason: Identify the smallest or largest opposite side before the inverse-cosine calculation.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the smallest angle, correct to the nearest minute.

spec.description: Unfilled grey triangle with horizontal base and apex left of centre; labels 5 outside the left side, 6 outside the right side and 7 below the base. No other marks.
spec.mathematics: Three sides 5, 6 and 7; source schematic proportions retained.

answer.worked:
The smallest angle is opposite side $5$.
$$\begin{align*}\cos\theta&=\frac{6^2+7^2-5^2}{2(6)(7)}\\[8pt]\theta&=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac57\right)\\[8pt]\theta&\approx44^\circ25'\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the largest angle, correct to the nearest minute.

spec.description: Broad unfilled grey triangle with horizontal base and apex left of centre; 8 outside the left side, 10 outside the right side and 14 below the base. No angle or vertex labels.
spec.mathematics: Three sides 8, 10 and 14; source schematic proportions retained.

answer.worked:
The largest angle is opposite side $14$.
$$\begin{align*}\cos\theta&=\frac{8^2+10^2-14^2}{2(8)(10)}\\[8pt]\theta&=\cos^{-1}\left(-\frac15\right)\\[8pt]\theta&\approx101^\circ32'\end{align*}$$
